clusters.pick_reason: #2124 is a patch-level fix that starts the keep-alive interval unconditionally inside the GET-stream handler (self-contained clearKeepAlive closure tied to the stream's own start/cancel lifecycle), so every deployment gets the fix with no config changes. #1726 ships the same behavior as a new opt-in keepAliveInterval option on WebStandardStreamableHTTPServerTransportOptions (threaded through a new keepAliveTimer field added to the shared StreamMapping interface) - it only takes effect if the operator explicitly sets the option, so the underlying idle-disconnect bug remains unresolved by default for anyone who upgrades without also changing their config.

clusters.pick_reason: #1996 implements a dedicated acceptsMediaType() parser that splits the Accept header into media-range entries, trims/lowercases them, and honors q=0 (explicitly-rejected) parameters before matching type/subtype. #2046 instead uses a bare acceptHeader?.includes('application/json') substring check, which has no handling for q=0 exclusions and is vulnerable to false-positive substring matches against unrelated media types (e.g. a hypothetical 'application/json-patch+json' or vendor type containing that substring). #1996's parsing approach is reusable for both the json and event-stream checks and is the more spec-correct fix for the same bug.

clusters.pick_reason: Both PRs make the identical core change to buildWellKnownPath (regex-strip all trailing slashes, which also collapses '/' to ''). #2214 stops there and leaves shouldAttemptFallback's root check as `pathname === '/'`, which no longer matches once the pathname is normalized to '' -- that mismatch causes an unnecessary extra fallback fetch on root-level discovery URLs. #2215 extracts the same normalization into a shared normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper and updates shouldAttemptFallback to check `pathname === ''`, keeping the two call sites consistent, so it fixes the double-slash bug without introducing the redundant-fallback regression that applying #2214 alone would leave behind.

members.title: chore(client): normalize trailing slashes in discovery paths
members.author: raashish1601
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2215: buildWellKnownPath() only stripped a single trailing slash from the discovery pathname, which could leave malformed double-slash well-known paths (e.g. '/foo//.well-known/...'). Both PRs fix this by stripping all trailing slashes via the same `pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '')` regex.
